description: A flat front with a neckline worked on held stitches. 30 sts are cast on and two chart rows of stockinette worked. On the next right-side row 9 sts are knit, the next 12 (the center neck) go on a holder and the remaining 9 (the right side) on a second holder, so only the 9 left-side stitches stay on the needle and the work turns. The left side is worked for 3 more rows and bound off on a right-side row. The right-side stitches go back on the needle with the RS facing (finishing the dividing row), are worked for 4 rows to match and bound off on a right-side row. Last, the center neck stitches go back with the RS facing, one row is knit and they are bound off on the wrong side. Every stitch is accounted for: 9 + 9 + 12 = 30 bound off and nothing left on hold.
covers: holding the next stitches from the middle of a row
holding the remaining stitches ends the row
two groups on hold at once
returning a group onto an empty needle with the RS facing
groups referred to by their hold step
written: Cast on 30 sts.
Section 1: Body
Row 1 (RS): k30 (30 sts on the needle)
Row 2 (WS): p30 (30 sts on the needle)
Section 2: Divide for the neck
Next row (RS): knit 9 sts. (30 sts on the needle, 21 still to work in this row)
Place the next 12 sts on a holder (center neck). (18 sts on the needle, 9 still to work in this row; 12 on hold)
Place the remaining 9 sts on a holder (right side). (9 sts on the needle; on hold: center neck 12, right side 9)
Section 3: Left side
Next row (WS): purl to end. (9 sts on the needle; on hold: center neck 12, right side 9)
Next row (RS): knit to end. (9 sts on the needle; on hold: center neck 12, right side 9)
Next row (WS): purl to end. (9 sts on the needle; on hold: center neck 12, right side 9)
Next row (RS): bind off all sts. (0 sts on the needle; on hold: center neck 12, right side 9; 9 bound off)
Section 4: Right side
With the RS facing, return the 9 sts on hold (right side) to the needle and join the yarn. (9 sts on the needle; 12 on hold; 9 bound off)
Next row (RS): knit to end. (9 sts on the needle; 12 on hold; 9 bound off)
Next row (WS): purl to end. (9 sts on the needle; 12 on hold; 9 bound off)
Next row (RS): knit to end. (9 sts on the needle; 12 on hold; 9 bound off)
Next row (WS): purl to end. (9 sts on the needle; 12 on hold; 9 bound off)
Next row (RS): bind off all sts. (0 sts on the needle; 12 on hold; 18 bound off)
Section 5: Neck edge
With the RS facing, return the 12 sts on hold (center neck) to the needle and join the yarn. (12 sts on the needle; 18 bound off)
Next row (RS): knit to end. (12 sts on the needle; 18 bound off)
Next row (WS): bind off all sts. (0 sts on the needle; 30 bound off)
